deferred: per-session execution history cap (transcript counts depend on it)
transcript virtualization and message-list rendering (recommended next)
explicitlyNotDone: no payload surgery (resume needs full context)

lifecycleOwnership.executions: controller/result/usage; interrupt(punning lookup), persistence snapshot, transcript counts; mirrored to run row
lifecycleOwnership.records: driver state; control calls + driver; in-memory by design
lifecycleOwnership.sessions: context/inbox/activity/result/usage/budget/compaction; transcript via DB fallback, control calls; persisted every settlement

measurementNote: deterministic synthetic stress, no model calls; heap delta only meaningful with --expose-gc (forced GC); without it the numbers show collection simply had not run yet. No RSS percentage claims.
method: unit + store-level tests (node:test, direct lifecycle calls, backdated completedAt for age, real SQLite); pristine-HEAD worktree A/B for failure attribution (no stash)

policy.evictUnit: session + its executions + its driver record
policy.trigger: spawn boundary (openRun), amortized O(sessions+executions), guarded try/catch

preExistingFailuresProvenIdenticalOnPris: subagentModelSelection 13/13 (electron mock getPath gap in test hook)
retentionGuaranteesKept: evicted transcripts serve from SQLite with task/result intact
subagent_runs rows never deleted by pruning
control calls on evicted ids throw explicit expiry (no hang, no misleading empty)
double settlement and repeat prune are no-ops
